segment_contamination_dimensions: Military/defence-exclusive buyers: names implying military, army, or defence-only use are blocked — 'Military Shelters' is a carved-out sibling MCAT with a distinct institutional defence buyer segment incompatible with the general industrial/commercial buyer of this MCAT.

Telecom-equipment-housing-exclusive buyers: names implying telecom BTS or equipment housing shelters are blocked — 'Telecom Shelters' is a carved-out sibling MCAT serving a specialised utility/telecom operator buyer segment distinct from general industrial buyers.

Livestock/agricultural-housing-exclusive buyers: names implying poultry or cattle housing are blocked — 'Poultry Sheds' and 'Cattle Sheds' are carved-out sibling MCATs serving farm animal housing buyers, a distinct sub-segment not served by general metal shelters.

Aircraft hangar buyers: names implying aircraft or aviation hangar use are blocked — 'Aircraft Hangars' is a carved-out sibling MCAT with a specialised aviation buyer segment incompatible with general industrial/commercial shelter buyers.

Swimming pool cover/shed buyers: names implying pool enclosure or pool roofing are blocked — 'Swimming Pool Tensile Cover' and 'Swimming Pool Shed' are carved-out sibling MCATs with a distinct leisure/hospitality buyer segment.
